description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling FeatureDefinitionDeleted events within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically related to persistence strategies in the thing management context.

classes.name: FeatureDefinitionDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a specific event handling strategy when a feature definition is deleted, extending AbstractThingEventStrategy for FeatureDefinitionDeleted events.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to apply a FeatureDefinitionDeleted event to a ThingBuilder, removing the feature definition specified by the event.
